title: Competitive Bingo game config
description: Response of GET /api/plugin/game. Describes the one game a join code refers to. See docs/api-contract.md section 4.1.

name.description: Human-readable game name, shown in the panel.

schemaVersion.description: Must equal the plugin's schema version or the plugin refuses to sync.

minPluginVersion.description: Semver. The plugin refuses to sync if its own version is older.

manualEntryAllowed.description: Whether this game accepts events the player typed in by hand. Null or omitted allows them, so a server predating the field behaves the way its players expect. Withholding the panel control is a convenience: a server that does not want them must reject source MANUAL on ingest.

screenshotsRequested.description: Whether the server wants screenshots for this game at all.

blockedWorldTypes.description: net.runelite.api.WorldType enum names this game refuses to count events from. Applied verbatim by the plugin; null or empty blocks nothing, and an unrecognised name is skipped. Must not reject the world named by startWorld.

startWorld.description: World the organiser wants players on. The panel offers a hop when the player is elsewhere. Null or omitted when the game does not care.

gameState.description: UPCOMING and LIVE accept sync; only LIVE accepts events. ENDED and LOCKED stop emission.

trackedMetrics.description: The only metric IDs the plugin may emit. Exact IDs, plus the two permitted wildcards. No other pattern form exists; a wildcard anywhere else is a malformed config and the plugin rejects it.

metricLabels.description: Metric ID (or wildcard string) to human-readable label, for the panel's Targets list. Display only; never behavioural. A label for a metric not in trackedMetrics is ignored, except one naming a dropValueRules entry.

metricTargets.description: Metric ID to how many of it the game wants, so the panel reads '5 Vorkath kills'. Display only, and more strongly so than metricLabels: the plugin does not track progress towards a target, does not stop reporting when one is met, and never reports how far along a player is. For a time. metric the figure is a threshold in milliseconds rather than a count.

dropValueRules.description: Metrics to emit for drops falling in a range of coin value. A rule's metricId does not need to appear in trackedMetrics; naming the rule is what asks for the metric. Null or empty means this game prices nothing and the plugin looks up no prices at all.

metricId.description: The metric ID to emit when a drop matches. Must be an exact ID under 'drop.'; a wildcard or any other namespace is a malformed config and the plugin refuses it.

label.description: Display label for the panel. Null falls back to the metric ID.

minValue.description: Inclusive lower bound in coins, or null for no lower bound. Must not exceed maxValue.

maxValue.description: Inclusive upper bound in coins, or null for no upper bound.

valuation.description: Which price to compare against. Null means GRAND_EXCHANGE. An item the client has no such price for matches no rule.

counts.description: What one matching stack contributes to delta. Null means ITEMS. VALUE sends the coin value of the stack, for a game scored on gp.
